title: TaintGuard policy
description: A TaintGuard policy layer: labels, the sources that add them to a session, and the sinks refused or asked while they are present.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows.

version.description: Policy format version. Only 1 is valid.

mode.description: enforce applies each sink's action; ask turns every deny into ask; audit turns every action into audit (dry run). Default enforce; the strictest layer wins.

subagents.description: Subagents share the session's taint set. The only value in version 1.

resetOnClear.description: Empty the taint set on /clear. Default true; honoured only from the managed or user layer.

userDeclassify.description: Whether /taintguard clear works, and whether it asks first. Default confirm; the strictest layer wins.

onUnknownHistory.description: What a rebuild does when the conversation history may be cut. Default assume-tainted; the strictest layer wins.

labels.description: The labels this layer declares, at least one. Names: letters, digits and -, 1 to 32 characters.

sources.description: Rules that add labels to the session when a tool call matches, or references that switch such rules off.

sinks.description: Rules that refuse, ask about or log tool calls while labels are present, or references that switch such rules off.

labelName.description: A label name: letters, digits and -, 1 to 32 characters.

ruleId.description: A rule id, unique within its layer: letters, digits, ., _ and -, 1 to 64 characters.

ruleRef.title: Rule reference
ruleRef.description: Switches off a rule by its namespaced id, when this layer may disable that layer's rules.

id.description: The namespaced id of the rule to switch off, such as preset:web-content.

enabled.description: Always false: a reference only switches a rule off.

sourceRule.title: Source rule
sourceRule.description: Adds labels to the session when a tool call matches.

match.description: The tool calls that fire this source.

on.description: attempt fires when the call is made, even if it is refused or fails; success fires only when it returns without error.

taints.description: The labels added, at least one.

sinkRule.title: Sink rule
sinkRule.description: Refuses, asks about or logs matching tool calls while its labels are present.

when.description: When the sink is active: anyOf holds when any listed label is present, allOf when all are; both present means both must hold; an empty object means always.

anyOf.description: Active when any of these labels is present.

allOf.description: Active when all of these labels are present.

block.description: The tool calls this sink acts on, at least one matcher.

except.description: Tool calls exempt from this sink even when a block matcher matches.

action.description: deny refuses the call; ask asks the user; audit only logs it.

reason.description: Shown to Claude and the user when the sink acts, at most 1,000 characters.

matcher.description: A tool selector plus optional argument predicates; all must hold.

arguments.description: Predicates on the call's arguments, all of which must hold.

selector.description: Selects tools by name: exactly one of exact, prefix, regex or anyOf; flags "i" only with prefix or regex.

prefix.description: The start of the tool's name.

regex.description: An ECMAScript regular expression tested against the tool's name; anchor it yourself.

anyOf.description: Tool names, any of which matches.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into the call's arguments, such as /file_path; empty for the whole arguments object.

predicate.description: A test on one argument: exactly one of equals, matches, notMatches or exists; flags "i" only with matches or notMatches.

equals.description: Holds when the value at the pointer is deeply equal to this JSON value.

matches.description: Holds when the value is present and its text matches this regular expression (non-strings are tested as their JSON).

notMatches.description: Holds when the value is absent or its text does not match this regular expression.

exists.description: true holds when the pointer resolves; false when it does not.
